repair_review: repair_running_output admits canonical state/revision, requires RUNNING distinct prior owner and live handle, checks full plan and typed output twice around equal-epoch provider callbacks, rereads state/revision, finds unique CLAIMED start, refuses clock rollback, validates transition and commits with lease-asserted atomic CAS; deadline is checked after commit and verified_output. Postcommit error may leave COMPLETE: reread. Result leaves execution/accounting/drain unverified. Lease checks PID, inode and flock, not GPU child drain. Source tests assert positive history, second-call refusal, live child lease, different-plan causal control, stale/missing/corrupt/provider/interrupt negatives, callback mutation, owner/state/deadline and postcommit reconciliation. They do not establish all races or live policy.
